    Profile

    Leon is a wanderer from Lustburg. He's a peculiar guy, who rather than using words, answers people by sounding his tambourine. It's his hobby to collect peculiar musical instruments from different parts of the world.

    Origin: Lustburg
    Gender: Male
    Height: 174cm
    Weight: 50kg
    Birthday: Feb 6
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Wind Goddess
    Likes: Peculiar musical instruments
    Hobbies: Collecting musical instruments
    Illust: なかつん
    CV: 佐藤拓也
